dataset_note: Corporate Earnings Call Sentiment Data (Alexandria). Each earnings call transcript is segmented into topic sections; for each section, NLP models produce trinary sentiment probabilities (POS/NTR/NEG), a confidence score, word count, and topic frequency. All fields are VECTOR type with one element per topic section. Data updates are event-driven (earnings calls are quarterly per company, but processed daily during earnings season).

oth296_prob_pos.description: Raw probability that the topic sentiment is positive; POS/NTR/NEG probabilities sum to 1

oth296_prob_neg.description: Raw probability that the topic sentiment is negative; POS/NTR/NEG probabilities sum to 1

oth296_prob_ntr.description: Raw probability that the topic sentiment is neutral; POS/NTR/NEG probabilities sum to 1

oth296_sentiment.description: Trinary sentiment label for the section/topic based on highest probability: 1=positive, 0=neutral, -1=negative

oth296_confidence.description: Normalized confidence of the sentiment classification derived from the Prob_ fields; ranges from 0 to 1

oth296_topic_count.description: Number of times the identified topic is discussed within the section

oth296_word_count.description: Number of words in the transcript section

oth296_call_time.description: UTC date and time of the earnings call

oth296_received_time.description: UTC timestamp when Alexandria received the transcript text
